follow_up_policy: After any formal metric is viewed, do not change weights, rebalance cadence, add assets or add any timing filter in this lineage. Other static allocations are separate preregistered architectures, not rescue tuning.
forbidden_changes: monthly, quarterly or semiannual rebalance rescue
momentum, trend, VIX, yield-curve, credit, Sahm, drawdown or volatility timing filters
adding gold, cash sleeve, S&P500 or other third asset after results
switching QQQ/TLT adjusted close to mismatched price-index comparators
shorting, leverage, financing, gross exposure above 100% or negative cash
hypothesis: A fixed equal-weight combination of a high-growth U.S. equity ETF and long-duration U.S. Treasury ETF exposes the portfolio to two structurally different macro return drivers: growth/risk appetite and duration/deflation. Annual rebalancing should harvest diversification and rebalancing effects with very low turnover, potentially reducing QQQ drawdown and improving risk-adjusted return without any timing signal or leverage.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
research_basis: structural diversification / rebalancing premium; this trial deliberately avoids forecasting, momentum and macro-state filters
measurement discipline: both economic assets are matched Yahoo adjusted-close total-return proxies rather than mixing ETF total return with price indices
selection_metric: No allocation search. Exactly 50/50 QQQ/TLT by equal-weight principle and one annual rebalance. Validation, objective and QQQ buy-hold comparison are independent ATM-SVP-3 axes.
